note: Hand-written labels for the Phase 8 events (the two Phase 7 cascades stay in labels.json). tier cascade = the label is CASCADING_CRISIS because a cited source shows an NYC-wide impact (flash flood emergency, emergency declaration, or flood-caused multi-line subway suspension). tier ambiguous = an NWS flash flood warning named NYC counties and the data coverage is good, but no cited source shows a cascade-class impact: these are NOT scored as cascade or noise, only watched. Onset and critical times are null unless a source gives a time. Episode starts come from the rule in start_rule.
start_rule: episode starts offset_min minutes BEFORE the start of the heaviest 60 minutes of rain at KNYC/KJFK/KLGA (IEM 1-minute data): a data-derived anchor, not an onset
